title: Speed up the parallel merge pipeline: scoped main suite, in-job merge gate, sccache, narrowed ONNX prefetch
goal: Cut per-merge latency: gate the merge-tree inside the serialized merge job instead of update-branch retest round-trips; run only affected shards on main; sccache + runner var on the compile gate; ONNX prefetch only when fastembed is in the closure.
